subject.title: fix(compaction): add circuit breaker to stop token burn when summarizer unavailable

question: Should staged compaction stop after exactly two consecutive generic fallback splits, accepting that later transcript chunks and the merge summary will be skipped?
rationale: The cutoff trades provider-token protection against session-context preservation, and neither existing behavior nor repository configuration defines the acceptable threshold.

options.title: Accept Two-Fallback Cutoff
options.body: Rebase the patch and land the typed two-fallback cutoff after proving the staged call sequence on current main.

options.title: Refine Failure Admission
options.body: Open the breaker only for structured provider-wide or repeated equivalent failures so chunk-specific failures do not suppress later summaries.

options.title: Pause This Approach
options.body: Keep current retry behavior until maintainers choose a broader compaction failure and recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Two-Fallback Cutoff
recommendation.body: Rebase the patch and land the typed two-fallback cutoff after proving the staged call sequence on current main.
